unverified_boundaries: Agent routing and interactive behavior have not been runtime-evaluated.
Scientific benchmark performance, representative-data behavior, and human-expert review have not been established.
The bundled self-test uses two synthetic two-gene source reports; representative cohorts, large matrices, and producer-version variation were not evaluated.
The helper verifies exact report-level GTF, gene-row, and assignment-contract agreement but cannot independently verify the underlying SAM, GTF, sample identity, protocol, or cohort suitability.
The full upstream reference dictionary is not present in the source-report schema, so equality is bounded to the GTF SHA-256 and gene tuples exposed by those reports.

Create-new publication has tested rollback after staged identity is recorded; a rare pre-identity failure may leave a hidden mode-0600 stage, it is not crash-atomic, and malicious same-directory writers were not evaluated.
Windows create-new publication and symlink semantics have not been verified.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The intended set of completed single-sample reports is absent or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Which completed reports belong in this matrix?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Use only samples counted against the same immutable GTF and fixed assignment policy for one intended cohort.

decision_sequence.applies_when: Upstream SAM/GTF review or source-report validity has not been established.
decision_sequence.question: Have these source reports and their upstream SAM/GTF contracts already been reviewed?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Stop and review them first; this skill verifies report agreement, not the underlying biological inputs.

runtime_versions: Python 3.12.8 self-test; compatible syntax requires Python >=3.10

runtime_verification.reason: Only the deterministic bundled small-synthetic helper self-test was performed. This verifies the fixed assembly contract, not formal exact-package agent runtime behavior, representative scientific performance, generalization, or expert review.
